name: CustomXMLPrefixMappings
description: Represents a collection of CustomXMLPrefixMapping objects.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the CustomXMLPrefixMappings object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the CustomXMLPrefixMappings object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the CustomXMLPrefixMappings object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the CustomXMLPrefixMappings collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a CustomXMLPrefixMapping object from the CustomXMLPrefixMappings collection. Read-only.

methods.name: AddNamespace
methods.signature: AddNamespace(Prefix As String, NamespaceURI As String)
methods.description: Allows you to add a custom namespace/prefix mapping to use when querying an item.

parameters.name: Prefix
parameters.description: Contains the prefix to add to the prefix mapping list.

parameters.name: NamespaceURI
parameters.description: Contains the namespace to assign to the newly added prefix.

methods.name: LookupNamespace
methods.description: Allows you to get the namespace corresponding to the specified prefix.

parameters.name: Prefix
parameters.description: Contains a prefix in the prefix mapping list.

methods.name: LookupPrefix
methods.description: Allows you to get a prefix corresponding to the specified namespace.
